Name: Simple Backpack Upgrade (New Update)
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]🎒 Simple Backpack Upgrade[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]PC · Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ · SMAPI 4.4.0+[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Buy twelve additional backpack slots at a time from Pierre, with optional progression up to [b]12,000 slots[/b]. Choose a price preset and return empty rows through Pierre’s backpack display.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🎒 Upgrade Progression[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]First buy the vanilla 36-slot Deluxe Pack, then purchase the mod’s 48- and 60-slot upgrades in order. The vanilla 24- and 36-slot upgrades keep their normal prices.

Upgrades beyond 60 slots are [b]Off by default[/b]. Enable [b]Extra upgrades[/b] in optional Generic Mod Config Menu and Save to continue. Without GMCM, set EnableExtraUpgrades to true in config.json while the game is closed.

Set a purchase limit up to 12,000 slots. Lowering that limit or disabling further upgrades retains capacity already purchased.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📦 Shipping Bin Inventory[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]The shipping bin automatically shows your unlocked backpack rows when the screen has room. The 48- and 60-slot upgrades can display all four or five rows without scrolling. Larger backpacks keep scrolling when needed, and your existing Visible backpack rows setting is respected.

The separate [b]+[/b] backpack page and its shortcut are unavailable while shipping. The shipping menu stays open with its side controls in place. Last-item undo remains above the backpack, and the layout adjusts when the window is resized. No extra shipping-bin setting is required.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🎒 Toolbar Row Limit[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Set [b]Shift Rows Limit[/b] in Generic Mod Config Menu. [b]All rows[/b] is the default. Choose [b]4 rows[/b] to cycle the toolbar through only the first four rows, or [b]5 rows[/b] for exactly five. A limit of 1 keeps the current toolbar row. Limits above your purchased row count use the rows you own. Open the dropdown and scroll within its list to choose another count, including 30 rows.

Extra storage remains accessible by scrolling. Without GMCM, close the game and set [b]ShiftRowsLimit[/b] to [b]4[/b] in config.json; use 0 for all rows.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💰 Price Presets[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Expensive is the default for future purchases:[/b]
48 slots — 250,000g
60 slots — 750,000g
72 slots — 2,000,000g
84 slots — 5,000,000g
96 slots — 6,000,000g
108 slots — 7,500,000g
120 slots — 9,500,000g

After 84 slots, the next row adds 1,000,000g; that increase grows by 500,000g with each later row. Prices cap at the game’s gold limit.

[b]Classic[/b] restores the previous prices. [b]Extreme[/b] doubles Expensive prices. [b]Custom[/b] uses your individual tier prices and later-row increase. Edited legacy price settings are retained in Custom; existing purchased capacity is unchanged.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]🧳 Trade In an Empty Row[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Use Pierre’s backpack display and choose [b]Trade in one backpack row[/b]. Empty the last twelve slots and put down any held/cursor item, then review the capacity change and refund before confirming. Each trade removes one row, down to a minimum of [b]36 slots[/b].

Refunds return [b]50% of the amount recorded when that row was purchased[/b]. Older upgrades and command-granted capacity without a purchase receipt explicitly show [b]0g[/b] before confirmation. Changing your price preset does not increase a recorded refund. Pan Slot’s separate equipped-pan slot is preserved.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#CBD5E1]Menu examples rendered with the native game interface.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52279/52279-1792525070-334793299.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🔗 Compatibility[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Includes Pan Slot reserved-pan preservation during inventory drawing, scrolling and capacity changes.

Expanded storage supports character, chest, shipping-bin and fishing-reward menus, plus supported [b]CJB Item Spawner 2.5.6[/b] layouts. Includes integrations for [b]UI Info Suite 2 2.3.7[/b] and [b]UI Info Suite 2 Alternative 2.9.0 / 2.9.1[/b]. These mods are optional.

Avoid another mod that changes backpack capacity or replaces the same inventory layouts. Settings, upgrade names and purchase/trade prompts support twelve languages.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]📦 Install or Update[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.4.0+[/url] and Stardew Valley 1.6.15+. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional.

Install [b]SimpleBackpackUpgrade[/b] in Mods with the game closed. When updating, replace the old mod files and keep your existing config.json. If updating from BiggerBackpack, rename that folder to SimpleBackpackUpgrade before replacing its files. Keep only one installed copy.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🧳 Before Removing[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Purchased capacity is saved on your farmer. Use Pierre’s trade-in option to return empty rows down to 36 slots, or move items out of extra slots before changing capacity or switching backpack mods. Removing the mod does not automatically reorganize those items.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Please post reports and ideas on this page. For bugs, include the mod version, game/SMAPI versions and platform, what happened versus what you expected, reproduction steps, and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url]. Add a screenshot or short video if helpful.

For suggestions, explain what you would like changed or added and how it would improve the mod.[/color][/size][/center]
